description: Defines a custom runtime exception class NotFoundException used for signaling 404 Not Found errors when resources are missing in the application.

classes.name: NotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending RuntimeException, used to indicate that a requested resource was not found.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an error message.
